newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London flat, blue chips avtive.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London flat, blue chips avtive.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London on Thursday remained around their closing Tokyo levels as blue chip stocks were subjected to a two-way pull by investors, dealers said.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index crept up 2.90 points to close at 1,610.62 after the Nikkei 225 index in Tokyo fell 75.01 points to 20,121.41.
Dealers said blue chips had fallen as the dollar/yen exchange fell below 114.00 but investors from Europe bought electrical stocks in the afternoon, limiting falls.
One of the more active stocks was NEC Corp which fell five yen to 1555 yen in two-way trade.
